cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Admit I helped with the opening of your speech. I taught you to state the argument before decorating it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, you wrote the opening paragraph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you kept the argument this time. Every section supports that opening, doesn't it? Read me the headings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me the section that doesn't depend on my opening. Follow the structure I taught you; if every heading leads back to it, put my name beside yours on the speech.
